the probable cause: Investigators believe that a lit cigarette was the probable cause of the fire in the apartment building.
調查人員認為，一根點燃的香菸是那棟公寓大樓火災的可能原因。
It is probable that…: It is probable that the train will be late, since heavy snow has been falling all morning.
火車很可能會誤點，因為大雪已經下了一整個早上。
the most probable outcome: Our team has not lost all season, so a win is the most probable outcome of tonight's game.
我們隊整季都沒輸過，所以今晚比賽最可能的結果是贏球。
highly probable: With the typhoon getting closer, it is highly probable that classes will be canceled tomorrow.
隨著颱風逼近，明天停課是極有可能的。
a productive meeting: We had a productive meeting this morning and finally agreed on a clear plan for the school festival.
我們今天早上開了一場有成果的會議，終於就校慶訂出明確的計畫。
productive land: Farmers moved to the river valley because its productive land could grow rice twice a year.
農民搬到河谷，因為那裡富饒的土地一年可以種兩次稻米。
a highly productive worker: Ken is a highly productive worker who finishes twice as many tasks as anyone else in the office.
阿肯是個生產力高的員工，完成的工作量是辦公室其他人的兩倍。
be productive of: Honest discussion can be productive of new ideas, even when people disagree with each other at first.
坦誠的討論能產生新的想法，即使大家一開始意見不合。
productive discussions: The teacher's clear questions led to productive discussions, and every group came up with useful ideas for the project.
老師清楚的提問帶出了有建設性的討論，每一組都為專題想出了有用的點子。
professional ethics: Doctors must follow professional ethics and never share a patient's private information with others.
醫生必須遵守職業道德，絕不把病人的隱私資訊透露給別人。
a professional athlete: After years of training, he became a professional athlete and now earns a living by playing tennis.
經過多年訓練，他成為一名職業運動員，現在靠打網球謀生。
turn professional: The young golfer decided to turn professional after winning several amateur competitions in a row.
這位年輕的高爾夫球手連續贏得幾場業餘比賽後，決定轉職業。
professional development: The school pays for workshops as part of teachers' professional development, helping them improve their teaching skills.
學校出錢讓老師參加研習，作為他們專業發展的一部分，幫助他們提升教學技巧。
seek professional advice: If your back pain lasts more than a week, you should seek professional advice from a doctor.
如果你的背痛持續超過一週，你應該向醫生尋求專業建議。
a professional manner: Although she was a new employee, she handled the angry customer in a professional manner, just like an experienced staff member.
雖然她是新員工，她卻以專業的態度處理那位生氣的顧客，就像資深員工一樣。
a profitable business: His bubble tea shop has become a profitable business, earning more money each month than he expected.
他的珍奶店已經成為賺錢的生意，每個月賺的錢都比他預期的多。
a profitable afternoon: Although studying in the library was boring, it was a profitable afternoon because I finished collecting all the data for my report.
雖然在圖書館讀書很無聊，但那是個收穫豐富的下午，因為我把報告的資料都蒐集完了。
a profitable experience: Working part-time at the bank was a profitable experience; I learned a lot about managing money and saved enough for a laptop.
在銀行打工是一段獲益良多的經歷；我學到很多理財知識，還存夠錢買了一台筆電。
prove profitable: Opening a second store near the university proved profitable, as students came in every day to buy snacks.
在大學附近開第二家店結果很有利可圖，因為學生每天都來買零食。
a profound effect: Reading that novel had a profound effect on me; it completely changed the way I think about life and death.
讀那本小說對我產生了深遠的影響；它徹底改變了我對生死的看法。
profound changes: The Internet has brought profound changes to the way people communicate, work, and learn around the world.
網路為世界各地人們溝通、工作和學習的方式帶來了深刻的變革。
a profound silence: When the principal announced the shocking news, a profound silence fell over the whole classroom.
校長宣布那個令人震驚的消息時，整間教室陷入一片深沉的寂靜。
profound knowledge: Professor Lin has profound knowledge of Chinese history, so students often ask him the most difficult questions.
林教授對中國歷史有淵博的知識，所以學生常問他最難的問題。
profound respect: I have profound respect for nurses who work long hours to take care of sick people.
我對長時間工作照顧病人的護理師懷有深深的敬意。
a profound question: The child asked a profound question about why people die, and even the adults had no easy answer.
那個孩子問了一個關於人為什麼會死的深奧問題，連大人都沒有簡單的答案。
progressive taxation: Under progressive taxation, people who earn more money pay a higher percentage of their income in taxes.
在累進稅制下，賺越多錢的人要繳的稅占收入的比例越高。
a progressive disease: Alzheimer's is a progressive disease, which means the patient's memory gets worse little by little over the years.
阿茲海默症是一種漸進惡化的疾病，意思是病人的記憶力會隨著時間一點一點變差。
progressive education: Schools that follow progressive education let students learn by doing projects instead of only memorizing facts.
採行進步主義教育的學校讓學生透過做專題來學習，而不只是背誦知識。
the progressive tense: We use the progressive tense, as in 'I am reading,' to describe actions happening right now.
我們用進行式，例如「I am reading」，來描述此刻正在進行的動作。
progressive policies: The new mayor introduced progressive policies, such as free bus rides and equal pay, to make the city fairer and more modern.
新市長推出進步派政策，例如免費公車和同工同酬，讓城市更公平、更現代化。
